heading.en: Energy that changes form but never runs out

hook.en: A block on a spring keeps trading *energy*: stored in the stretched spring at the ends, carried as motion in the middle. The total stays the same.
hook.kn: ಸ್ಪ್ರಿಂಗ್ ಮೇಲಿನ ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ವಿನಿಮಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ: ತುದಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಪ್ರಿಂಗ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ, ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಲನೆಯಾಗಿ. ಒಟ್ಟು ಶಕ್ತಿ ಸ್ಥಿರ.

title.en: Write the kinetic and potential energy in SHM
Show that the total energy is ½kA²

say.en: A block on a spring keeps trading energy: stored in the stretched spring at the ends, carried as motion in the middle. The total stays the same. In this lesson: Write the kinetic and potential energy in SHM.
Show that the total energy is one half kA squared.

body.en: At displacement x, the potential energy is U = ½kx² and the *kinetic* energy is K = ½mv² = ½k(A² − x²). Their sum E = ½kA² = ½mω²A² is constant: it depends on the square of the amplitude. At the mean position all the energy is kinetic; at the extremes it is all potential.
body.kn: x ಸ್ಥಾನಪಲ್ಲಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಶಕ್ತಿ U = ½kx², ಚಲನ ಶಕ್ತಿ K = ½k(A² − x²). ಒಟ್ಟು ಶಕ್ತಿ E = ½kA² ಸ್ಥಿರ. ಸಮತೋಲನ ಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಚಲನ ಶಕ್ತಿ; ತುದಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಶಕ್ತಿ.

say.en: E equals one half kA squared is proportional to A squared.
Potential energy of a spring is one half k x squared: a parabola against x.
The total energy E = one half k A squared is constant: a flat line. Kinetic energy is the gap between E and U.
At the mean position all the energy is kinetic; at the extremes it is all potential. K equals U at x = A over root 2.
Against time, K and U each peak twice in one oscillation, so they vary at twice the frequency, while their sum stays flat.
Example: k = 100 newton per metre, A = 10 centimetres. E is half a joule. At x = 5 centimetres, U is 0.125 joule and K is 0.375 joule.

narration.en: Potential energy ½kx² (blue) is largest at the ends; kinetic energy ½mv² (green) is largest in the middle. Without friction their total stays ½kA². The parabola is the potential energy curve; the gap up to the total line is the kinetic energy. Turn on damping and the total slowly falls.
narration.kn: ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಶಕ್ತಿ ½kx² (ನೀಲಿ) ತುದಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ; ಚಲನ ಶಕ್ತಿ ½mv² (ಹಸಿರು) ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ. ಘರ್ಷಣೆ ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ½kA² ಸ್ಥಿರ. ಪರವಲಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಶಕ್ತಿ ವಕ್ರ; ಒಟ್ಟು ರೇಖೆಯವರೆಗಿನ ಅಂತರ ಚಲನ ಶಕ್ತಿ. ಮಂದನ ಆನ್ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A spring of k = 200 N m⁻¹ oscillates with amplitude 0.05 m. Find the total energy, and the potential and kinetic energies at x = 0.03 m.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A spring of k = 200 N m⁻¹ oscillates with amplitude 0.05 m. Find the total energy, and the potential and kinetic energies at x = 0.03 m.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A spring of k equals 200 newtons m to the power minus 1 oscillates with amplitude 0.05 metres. Find the total energy, and the potential and kinetic energies at x equals 0.03 metres.
E equals one half kA squared equals one half times 200 times 0.0025 equals 0.25 joules.
U equals one half kx squared equals one half times 200 times 0.0009 equals 0.09 joules.
K equals E - U equals 0.16 joules.
So the answer is E equals 0.25 joules; U equals 0.09 joules; K equals 0.16 joules.
